title: Shiny Rock Boat Rental
gap: Prices and rental durations are not stated.
blurb: Shiny Rock Boat Rental offers boat rentals with a clear cancellation policy. Cancellations more than 14 days before rental get 100% refund minus 3% fee; within 14 days get 50% refund minus 3% fee; within 3 days get no refund. Exceptions apply for extenuating circumstances such as severe weather, death in family, natural disasters, political unrest, or boat issues.
